campaign_logline: The great trade arteries are rotting. As the backbone of local commerce decays, you must navigate a web of negligence, sabotage, and desperate competition.
opening_situation: Zenith, Aurelia, and Vanguard are struggling to maintain basic connectivity. Relay stations are failing, docking fees are skyrocketing, and everyone is blaming the neighbors for the 'planned' decay.
main_mystery: Who intentionally allowed the infrastructure to fail, and which corporation is currently profiting from the resulting repair monopoly?
act_1_outline: Secure local trade routes between Zenith and Aurelia by replacing failing relay cores.
Identify a mole within Vanguard's logistics chain who is siphoning parts for black market sale.
Negotiate a temporary ceasefire between rival factions to repair the primary jump-gate to the next sector.
long_term_reveal: The infrastructure wasn't failing; it was being decommissioned by a shell company owned by one of the main faction heads.
core_pressure: Resource scarcity and escalating repair costs for ship systems.
kaelen_rule: Kaelen is publicly a broker; she handles contracts and manages logistics with an icy, professional demeanor.
faction_reveal_rule: New factions are only revealed upon jumping through gates to new systems.
humor_rule: Dry, sarcastic commentary on the absurdity of corporate bureaucracy and orbital physics.
address_rule: NPCs address the player as 'Contractor', 'Pilot', or by their ship's designation.
fallback_rule: If a narrative gap occurs, generate a standard 'Local Cargo Escort' quest with varying rewards.
story_horizon_rule: Trigger: active_story_arcs_remaining < 1; Action: append_story_horizon; Description: Expand the scope as the player moves further from the core.

story_arcs.name: The Maintenance Monopoly
story_arcs.summary: Investigate why spare parts for gate stabilizers have become rarer than solid gold on the open market.

rumor_trails.name: Ghost Signal at Outpost 9
clue_templates: A frantic log entry regarding 'Project Dead-End'.
A manifest showing a shipment of parts delivered to a non-existent warehouse.
rumor_trails.payoff: An encrypted file containing the names of every officer involved in the planned decommissioning.

regeneration_triggers.description: Generate a new local conflict when the current narrative arc is completed.

expansion_rules: Do not retcon player choices; treat previous actions as established history.
Append new content to the tail of the campaign sequence to maintain continuity.
